p: Eagles Meadow is right in the heart of Wrexham, so you can bounce and then walk straight into town. Wrexham was given city status in 2022, and it's had a fair bit of attention lately, mostly thanks to the football club. Wrexham AFC were bought by Hollywood actors Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney, and their story has been told in the TV series Welcome to Wrexham. You'll spot red shirts and plenty of fans visiting the Racecourse Ground, which is a short walk from the centre.

Wrexham has a far older story too. St Giles' Church is the town's grand medieval church, with a soaring tower, and its churchyard is the resting place of Elihu Yale, whose name lives on at the famous American university. It's an interesting little fact to share with older kids.
Wrexham Museum, in the town centre, covers the history of the area, from prehistoric finds to the coal and brewing trades that shaped the town.

Further afield, Chirk Castle, a National Trust fortress with gardens and parkland, sits near the English border, and Llangollen is a lovely drive up the Dee Valley. There you'll find the Horseshoe Falls and the Llangollen Railway, a heritage line that follows the river.

Match days can make getting around the centre slower, so if you want an easy trip, check whether Wrexham are at home before you set off. On a quiet day, though, the city is easy to walk, and there are plenty of places to grab a bite after your session.
Little ones will enjoy the town's parks too.
